svg.title: Four independently sourced ecological routes to floral selection
svg.desc: Panel A Gymnadenia pollination by herbivory gradient; B Lythrum clipping changes phenotype and selection; C Brassica bee and butterfly behaviors, oviposition and seed selection; D Pedicularis cross-stage heterogeneity source Table 2.
svg.text: Ecological context can enter selection at different stages
Four independently published systems; source values are not a common pooled effect size
Selection on flowering start (β ± source SE)
Opposite source-supported gradients; phenotype not randomized
Sletvold et al. 2015 · Appendix Table A2
Source treatment means and within-state selection β
Mean flowering end: day 236 in both groups
Regrowth pathway plausible; eight controls reassigned
Source trait associations across distinct response models
Net selection on corolla size (seed fitness):
Knauer & Schiestl 2017 · Tables 1–3 | nominal P only
Different P-value decisions ≠ different effect sizes
No water-only manipulation or trait-dependent G test
SOURCE-BASED OBSERVATIONS: four separate studies; no randomized trait z × pollinator P × antagonist G surfaces.
